name: Shaanxi Aerospace Power Hi-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Aerospace Power Hi-Tech Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells pumps and pump systems, hydraulic transmission products, fluid metering products, and motors in China and internationally. The company offers pumps and pump systems comprising industrial reciprocating pumps, such as coalbed fracturing pumps and oilfield water injection pumps; chemical process pumps and high- and low-pressure coal slurry pumps; large hydraulic pumps; small and medium-sized water turbines; and industrial electric motors.
